source: Kenya Judiciary website - Court Station Contacts
note: Phone numbers as listed on source (dial with 0 prefix domestically or +254 internationally, dropping the leading 0). 'location' is the county the station falls in, inferred from the court/town name. 'type' is the court class (High Court, Court of Appeal, Law Court/Magistrate's Court, Tribunal, etc.). 'judges' is populated only for Supreme Court entries (the only bench-level roster supplied, as of July 2026); all other court classes leave 'judges' as an empty array pending further data.
